integrity_note: Proof reconstructs the group isomorphism using integral cohomology, Koszul line-bundle cohomology and adjunction; finite exact checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth complex complete intersections of a smooth Wehler hypersurface with a nonuniform multidegree vector of entries at least three, in products of at least six projective lines.
No claimed optimality of degree or dimension bounds, or computation of each individual stabilizer.
Bibliographic risk from a possible older general multiprojective automorphism-extension theorem.
title: Ambient automorphism rigidity for asymmetric Wehler sections
